legend: The tumour cell nests infiltrate into the dermis and smooth muscle of the nipple and areola. Cysts containing keratin are present in the superficial portion.

Immunostaining for p63 shows positive nuclear reactivity in small solid nests, as well as in larger nests with squamous differentiation. Centrally located p63-negative tumour cells can be seen in a cluster of tumour cells forming a tubule.

Nipple-areolar lump shows a syringomatous tumour composed of permeative nests and elongated islands of epithelial cells which are predominantly solid, with rare nests disclosing small lumens. A squamoid appearance is seen in some nests.
